instruction: Change the GNOME interface font to Ubuntu 12 using the GNOME Tweaks tool or gsettings.

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing GNOME interface font to 'Ubuntu 12'. Evaluator checks gsettings org.gnome.desktop.interface font-name contains 'Ubuntu 12'.

llm_judge_reasons: Postconfig correctly executes 'gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.interface font-name' to retrieve the current GNOME interface font setting
Getter (get_cache_file) correctly reads the cached gsettings output file
Metric (check_list) appropriately uses regex pattern matching to verify 'Ubuntu 12' appears in the output
Expected value pattern ['Ubuntu 12'] correctly matches the gsettings output format which returns quoted strings like 'Ubuntu 12'
Evaluator fully covers the instruction requirement by checking the exact font-name setting that the instruction asks to change
Runtime execution is feasible - command will execute, output will be cached, and pattern matching will work correctly
Edge cases handled properly - returns 0.0 if font not changed, file missing, or empty
